recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to plain white (#FFFFFF).
2. Draw the header band: a light gray rectangle (exact hex unspecified; use ~#D9D9D9) spanning the full slide width, covering the top 0-15% of slide height.
3. Place the title centered on the header band in bold red (#B22222) sans-serif, medium-large: 'How to obtain the BEST model parameters (W)', with '(W)' in blue (#0000CC).
4. Place the slide-number icon at the top-right of the header band: a yellow circle (#FFF2A8 fill, #8B0000 outline) containing the number '20'.
5. Draw the flowchart container: a large rectangle with a red (#CC0000) border and white fill, spanning the full width at ~15-60% of slide height.
6. Place Box 1 at the left inside the container: a green (#1E7B34) filled rectangle labeled 'Training Sample' in bold white text.
7. Place a handwritten-style blue (#0000CC) 'X' with an underline stroke directly above Box 1.
8. Draw Arrow 1: a red (#CC0000) horizontal arrow pointing right, from Box 1 to Box 2.
9. Place Box 2: a large dark-red (#8B0000) filled rectangle labeled 'Classification Model (with Model Parameters)' in white text, with the second line '(with Model Parameters)' in italics.
10. Draw Arrow 2: a red (#CC0000) horizontal arrow pointing right, from Box 2 to Box 3.
11. Place Box 3: a light-cyan (#D6F5F5) filled rectangle labeled 'Predicted Output (Label)' in bold black text.
12. Place a handwritten-style blue (#0000CC) 'ŷ' directly above Box 3.
13. Draw Arrow 3: a red (#CC0000) horizontal arrow pointing right, from Box 3 to Box 4.
14. Place Box 4: a tall, narrow beige (#F5E6C8) rectangle with the label 'Error' rotated to run vertically.
15. Place Box 5 to the right of Box 4: a pale-yellow (#FFFACD) filled rectangle labeled 'True Label of the Sample'.
16. Place a handwritten-style blue (#0000CC) 'y' with a small arrow stroke directly above Box 5.
17. Draw Arrow 4: a red (#CC0000) arrow pointing LEFT from Box 5 into Box 4 (Error).
18. Place a small beige (#F5E6C8) label box reading 'Training Sample with Label', centered above the flow inside the container.
19. Draw two thin curved gray (#808080) arrows starting at the 'Training Sample with Label' label and arcing down: one to the 'X' above Box 1, one to the 'y' above Box 5.
20. Place the key sentence below the container at ~62-70% of slide height, centered horizontally, in red (#CC0000): 'Try to obtain model parameters by minimizing the Error (Loss Function)', with the word 'Error' in blue (#0000CC) bold.
21. Draw the note box: a pale-yellow (#FFFDE7) rectangle with a thin red (#CC0000) border, spanning the full width at ~72-95% of slide height.
22. Inside the note box, place 'Note:' in bold black as the first line.
23. On the next line, place black text 'There are three terms that are commonly used interchangeably' followed by the red italic parenthetical '(though there is a difference)'.
24. On the next line, place 'Loss function , Error function, and Objective function (to be discussed later)' with 'Loss', 'Error', and 'Objective' in red (#CC0000) bold and '(to be discussed later)' in blue (#0000CC).
25. Place a handwritten-style blue (#0000CC) 'Cost' in script at the bottom-right corner inside the note box.
